external_boundaries.content: General legal references, provision identifiers and questions without client documents or identifying case facts.
controls: Use the current legal-question method; do not include credentials or attach private case files. Retain actual sources and access limits.
external_boundaries.destination: Public legal sources through the selected host research tools
external_boundaries.purpose: Verify authorities needed for the selected question

classes.content: The model reads the document’s claims, relevant dates and retrieved source text. Host research may send general legal references to consulted sites; queries must not include client documents or identifying facts. The local record stores quotations, passages and limitations without network requests. Source access depends on host tools and permissions.
classes.purpose: Carry out verifica-citazioni using the selected evidence and user instructions

de: Das Modell liest Dokumentaussagen, maßgebliche Daten und beschaffte Quellentexte. Die Host-Recherche kann allgemeine Rechtsfundstellen an besuchte Seiten senden; Mandantendokumente und identifizierende Sachverhalte gehören nicht in Suchanfragen. Das lokale Register speichert Zitate, Passagen und Grenzen ohne Netzwerkanfragen. Zugang hängt von Host-Werkzeugen und Berechtigungen ab.
en: The model reads the document’s claims, relevant dates and retrieved source text. Host research may send general legal references to consulted sites; queries must not include client documents or identifying facts. The local record stores quotations, passages and limitations without network requests. Source access depends on host tools and permissions.
es: El modelo lee afirmaciones, fechas pertinentes y textos de fuentes obtenidos. La investigación del anfitrión puede enviar referencias jurídicas generales a los sitios consultados; las búsquedas no deben incluir documentos ni hechos identificativos del cliente. El registro local conserva citas, pasajes y límites sin solicitudes de red. El acceso depende de herramientas y permisos del anfitrión.
fr: Le modèle lit affirmations, dates pertinentes et textes des sources acquis. La recherche de l’hôte peut envoyer des références juridiques générales aux sites consultés ; aucune pièce ou donnée identifiante du client ne doit figurer dans les requêtes. Le registre local conserve citations, passages et limites sans requête réseau. L’accès dépend des outils et autorisations de l’hôte.
it: Il modello legge le affermazioni del documento, le date pertinenti e i testi delle fonti acquisiti. Le ricerche dell’host possono inviare riferimenti giuridici generali ai siti consultati; non devono includere documenti o fatti identificativi del cliente. Il registro locale conserva citazioni, passaggi e limiti senza effettuare richieste di rete. L’accesso alle fonti dipende dagli strumenti e dalle autorizzazioni dell’host.
